# Classify files for audit and remediation
[API index](index.md) | [Definition schema](schema.md)
| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `files.classify.workflow` |
| Source | `06_workflows/files.classify.workflow.yaml` |
| Tags | workflow |
Classify files for audit and remediation. This workflow is designed to
be run on a regular schedule (e.g. daily) to keep the file classification up to date as files
are added, removed, or modified. It can also be run on demand to trigger an immediate audit
and remediation cycle.

### Run Operations
#### Python
_No operation description provided._
```python
from pathlib import Path
from core.environment import REPO_ROOT, data
from lib.classify.build_manifest import build_classification
from lib.files import write_json
manifests_dir = data("manifests")
manifests_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
classification_report, current_state_manifest, fingerprint_report = build_classification(REPO_ROOT)
write_json(manifests_dir / "classification_report.json", classification_report)
write_json(manifests_dir / "current_state_manifest.json", current_state_manifest)
write_json(manifests_dir / "fingerprint_report.json", fingerprint_report)
print("Wrote classification_report.json")
print("Wrote current_state_manifest.json")
print("Wrote fingerprint_report.json")
```
